On case 0 it emits "You feel a wrenching sensation." then calls tele(); tele() delegates to scrolltele(NULL), which reaches controlled getpos when the game is in wizard mode. The selected debug-mode Barbarian recording enters this arm; JS currently records a gap at the call instead of running teleport.

JS read.js:doread() -> spell.js:study_book() -> spell.js:cursed_book(); the selected v42 recording reaches the study_book() too-hard caller.
